short: I offer virtual wellness coaching for women who care for others at home or at work. Together, we look at what drains your energy and choose small changes that fit your week.
certs: Functional Medicine Coaching Academy, health coach certification.
training: Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN). Registered nurse with experience in intensive care, interventional radiology, and virtual nursing. Completed health coach training at the Functional Medicine Coaching Academy.
integrative: Completed the Functional Medicine Coaching Academy health coach certification program.
pricing: Free 15-minute introductory phone consultation. Beyond Burnout group coaching: $49 introductory price for four sessions. Individual coaching is offered as a four-session package over eight weeks.
long: I’m Laura Pelech, a registered nurse and wellness coach in New York’s Capital District. I work with women who spend much of their day caring for others and want more time and energy for themselves. In individual coaching, we look at a typical week, identify where you want support, and choose one change to try before we meet again. I also offer Beyond Burnout, a small coaching group for caregivers, and community workshops. You’re welcome to book a free 15-minute phone consultation through my website.
size: A solo coaching practice offering individual sessions, small groups of up to six participants, and community workshops.
